content_es: Redis ofrece múltiples estructuras de datos optimizadas. Strings: valores simples, SET y GET. Lists: colecciones ordenadas, LPUSH/RPUSH agregan, LPOP/RPOP quitan. Sets: colecciones desordenadas de valores únicos, SADD agrega, SINTER/SUNION hacen operaciones. Sorted Sets: sets con score, ZADD agrega con score, se ordenan automáticamente. Hashes: mapeos campo-valor, HSET establece, HGET recupera. Cada estructura está optimizada para patrones específicos: usa Strings para cachés simples, Lists para colas, Sets para membresía rápida, Sorted Sets para rankings, Hashes para objetos.
content_en: Redis offers multiple optimized data structures. Strings: simple values, SET and GET. Lists: ordered collections, LPUSH/RPUSH add, LPOP/RPOP remove. Sets: unordered collections of unique values, SADD adds, SINTER/SUNION perform operations. Sorted Sets: sets with score, ZADD adds with score, auto-ordered. Hashes: field-value mappings, HSET sets, HGET retrieves. Each structure is optimized for specific patterns: use Strings for simple caches, Lists for queues, Sets for fast membership, Sorted Sets for rankings, Hashes for objects.
